fixedVersionNote: The fix is 3.1.0, but d3-color 3.x is ESM-only: require() throws ERR_REQUIRE_ESM, and the package's "exports" map also blocks the UMD fallback (require("d3-color/dist/d3-color.js") -> ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED), so the CommonJS PoC cannot load the fixed tree at all. Vulnerable 2.0.0 reproduces at 2.43 s. Making this runnable means porting the exploit to dynamic import() under an ESM-capable jest config; until then fixedVersion stays n/a rather than generating an image whose baseline fails on a module-load error that looks like a closed vulnerability.
